SCENE sc_001 0-39000 EXT. MEDICINAL GARDEN – DAY
EP17:E1 0-3000 CAMERA: High angle wide shot looking down at the muddy, trampled garden. Broken wooden planters and splintered planks litter the ground as Juliana kneels amidst the ruined soil.
EP17:E2 0-3000 ACTION: Juliana sits on her knees in her dirt-smudged dress, her hands wrapped in clean linen bandages, sorrowfully examining the wreckage. In the distant background, Alexander paces near the perimeter fence.
EP17:E3 3000-7000 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's bandaged hand reaching into the dark earth of a battered planter box.
EP17:E4 3000-7000 ACTION: Juliana gently lifts a tiny, delicate white daisy clinging to its exposed roots out of the soil, cupping it in her palm.
EP17:E5 7000-11500 CAMERA: Medium close-up tilting up to Juliana's face, bruised and tear-streaked yet filled with fragile hope.
EP17:E6 9300-11300 JULIANA [Soft, Emotional]: "Some of them survived."
EP17:E7 11500-14000 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Alexander repairing the broken wooden fence with a heavy iron hammer.
EP17:E8 11500-14000 SOUND: Rhythmic, heavy thuds of an iron hammer pounding into weathered wood.
EP17:E9 11500-14000 ACTION: Alexander firmly drives nails into a fractured fence post, his brow furrowed with focused determination.
EP17:E10 14000-16200 CAMERA: Wide shot framing Juliana kneeling on the wet cobblestones in the foreground while Alexander stands by the fence behind her, lowering his hammer.
EP17:E11 14300-15300 JULIANA [Grateful, Sincere]: "Thank you."
EP17:E12 16200-18000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander turning toward her, his scarred face stoic and intense.
EP17:E13 16800-17800 ALEXANDER [Gruff, Low]: "For what?"
EP17:E14 18000-21000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.
EP17:E15 18200-20500 JULIANA [Trembling, Heartfelt]: "For standing between me and those men."
EP17:E16 21000-23500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.
EP17:E17 21500-23000 ALEXANDER [Unwavering, Firm]: "I would do it again."
EP17:E18 23500-25800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.
EP17:E19 24000-25700 JULIANA [Whispering, Awed]: "Even if there were ten of them?"
EP17:E20 26000-27700 ALEXANDER [Deep, Resolute]: "As long as I draw breath..."
EP17:E21 26500-30000 CAMERA: Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.
EP17:E22 28000-31500 ACTION: Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.
EP17:E23 28800-31000 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Vowing]: "...no one will hurt you again."
EP17:E24 31500-34500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's tear-filled face, overwhelmed by his fierce devotion.
EP17:E25 32800-34200 JULIANA [Choked Up, Pained]: "You cannot promise that."
EP17:E26 34500-36500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's intense, protective gaze locking onto hers.
EP17:E27 34800-35800 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Absolute]: "I just did."
EP17:E28 36500-39000 CAMERA: Close-up of their joined hands, his rugged, scarred fingers wrapping securely around her bandaged fingers.
EP17:E29 36500-39000 ACTION: Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
SCENE sc_002 39000-118880 INT. COTTAGE HEARTH – NIGHT
EP17:E30 39000-42000 CAMERA: Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.
EP17:E31 40000-44500 ACTION: Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.
EP17:E32 42000-45000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands delicately pressing the white cloth against Alexander's wounded knuckles.
EP17:E33 42800-44700 JULIANA [Tender, Reproachful]: "You were bleeding last night."
EP17:E34 45000-48500 CAMERA: Medium close-up showing Alexander gazing down at her, his expression softening with unspoken affection as he gently takes hold of her wrist.
EP17:E35 46000-47300 ALEXANDER [Quiet, Fond]: "So were you."
EP17:E36 48500-51500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, a faint, tender smile gracing her lips.
EP17:E37 49000-51500 JULIANA [Softly Teasing]: "You make it very difficult to argue with you."
EP17:E38 51500-54000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander ducking his chin, a subtle, bashful smile fleetingly touching his scarred face.
EP17:E39 53500-56000 ACTION: Juliana returns the damp cloth to the ceramic basin, her expression turning somber and reflective.
EP17:E40 54000-58500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her vulnerability resurfacing in the warm amber glow.
EP17:E41 56500-58000 JULIANA [Vulnerable, Sincere]: "I was frightened."
EP17:E42 58500-60500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowing with sudden concern.
EP17:E43 58800-59800 ALEXANDER [Questioning]: "Of them?"
EP17:E44 60500-63500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana gazing directly into his eyes, her heart laid bare.
EP17:E45 60800-62200 JULIANA [Whispering, Earnest]: "Of losing you."
EP17:E46 63500-66000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander visibly moved, his gaze softening with profound emotion.
EP17:E47 66000-73500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stands and pulls Juliana gently to her feet against his broad chest.
EP17:E48 66000-73500 ACTION: Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest, closing her eyes as his strong arms wrap around her shoulders, holding her safe against his frame.
EP17:E49 73500-78000 CAMERA: Close-up on their faces nestled together in the firelight, Alexander resting his bearded chin against her hair.
EP17:E50 77000-81000 ACTION: Juliana nestles deeper into his coat, listening intently to the rapid thudding beneath his chest.
EP17:E51 78500-80000 JULIANA [Soft, Playful]: "Your heart is racing."
EP17:E52 80500-83500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander tilting his head down toward her, a tender smile breaking through his rugged beard.
EP17:E53 81200-82500 ALEXANDER [Warm, Whispering]: "So is yours."
EP17:E54 83500-87500 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the couple embraced in front of the roaring, glowing fireplace.
EP17:E55 86500-90000 ACTION: Juliana slowly raises her hand, gently twirling a lock of Alexander's long, unruly dark hair between her fingers.
EP17:E56 87500-90000 CAMERA: Close-up of her delicate fingers running through his thick strands of hair.
EP17:E57 88000-89800 JULIANA [Lighthearted, Teasing]: "This is becoming impossible."
EP17:E58 90000-93000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana beaming up at him with affectionate humor.
EP17:E59 90400-92500 JULIANA [Smiling]: "Soon birds will start nesting in it."
EP17:E60 93000-96000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander regarding her with a subtle, affectionate smirk.
EP17:E61 93500-95200 ALEXANDER [Dry, Amused]: "They have not complained yet."
EP17:E62 95500-97000 ACTION: Juliana lets out a quiet, melodic laugh.
EP17:E63 96000-100000 CAMERA: Medium close-up as Juliana lifts her bandaged hand toward his beard playfully.
EP17:E64 96500-99200 JULIANA [Charming, Tender]: "Then I shall have to save you from the birds."
EP17:E65 99500-102500 ACTION: Alexander gently catches her wrist mid-air, holding her hand firmly against his chest while looking into her eyes with solemn sincerity.
EP17:E66 100300-101500 ALEXANDER [Solemn, Gentle]: "Not yet."
EP17:E67 102500-105000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes shining with quiet patience and understanding.
EP17:E68 103000-104200 JULIANA [Sweet, Reassuring]: "Then I will wait."
EP17:E69 105000-108000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander releasing a quiet breath of gratitude, pulling her closer against his shoulder.
EP17:E70 107000-114000 ACTION: Juliana rests her head against Alexander's collarbone once more, wrapping both arms around him as he cradles her head in his palm.
EP17:E71 108000-112000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's peaceful face resting against Alexander's rugged chest.
EP17:E72 108300-111500 JULIANA [V.O.) (Reflective, Resonant]: "I know almost nothing about the man I married."
EP17:E73 112000-118880 CAMERA: Slow pull-back wide shot of Alexander and Juliana locked in a tender, enduring embrace before the radiant, roaring hearth as the fire crackles peacefully.
EP17:E74 112200-116000 JULIANA [V.O.) (Deeply Moved, Loving]: "But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him."
EP17:E75 114000-118880 SOUND: Warm crackle of embers in the hearth blending with swelling, tender orchestral strings holding into the fade-out.
